connections.selectCompany: Select a company to manage apps.
connections.title: Connections
connections.description: The tools you’ve connected, and whether they’re working.
connections.waitingOne: 1 action is waiting for your OK
connections.waitingMany: {{count}} actions are waiting for your OK
connections.waitingBody: Your agents paused to check with you before making a change.
connections.appsAvailable: Apps you connect become available to every agent unless you change “Who can use it”.
connections.deleteBody: Agents will lose access immediately. You can connect it again later.
connections.deleteBodyWithOthers: This connection will be removed. Agents can still use {{name}} through {{count}} other active connections.
connections.deleteBodyWithOthersOne: This connection will be removed. Agents can still use {{name}} through 1 other active connection.
connections.deletedWithOthers: {{name}} still has {{count}} active connections available to agents.
connections.deletedWithOthersOne: {{name}} still has 1 active connection available to agents.
connections.deletedLast: {{name}} is no longer available to agents. You can connect it again later.
connections.emptyBody: Add one from Apps to give your agents the tools they need.
connections.reconnectOAuth: Reconnect required — sign in again to restore access.
connections.reconnectKey: The key stopped working — reconnect to fix.
connections.pausedHint: Paused — agents can’t use it right now.
connections.connectHint: Connect it so agents can use it.

review.selectCompany: Select a company to review approvals.
review.title: Review
review.description: Actions your agents want to run that need your OK first. Approve, always-allow, or decline.
review.empty: Nothing is waiting for your OK right now.
review.fallback: An agent wants to run this action. It can change something, so we’re checking with you first.

byo.title: Connect your own tool
byo.body: Paste the URL from a custom or self-hosted MCP server and review its actions before enabling it.

notConnected.removedBody: {{name}} no longer shows in your apps. You can connect it again any time.
notConnected.alreadyBody: Open a connection to edit it, or add another account.
notConnected.connectAnotherBody: Add another {{name}} account without changing the connections above.
notConnected.keptSetup: We kept the previous setup. Add a working key to bring it back online.
notConnected.cannotUse: Agents can’t use it until it’s connected.
notConnected.permissionsBody: Reconnect this app to edit who can use it and which actions need a human first.
notConnected.permissionsRetained: Previous setup is retained for reconnect, but access controls stay read-only until the app is online.
notConnected.detailsBody: Technical details will appear here after this app is connected.

gateway.selectCompany: Select a company to manage gateways.
gateway.title: Apps
gateway.description: A gateway is one safe MCP endpoint that exposes only the apps you assign. Hand it to a client like Cursor or Claude Desktop.
gateway.search: Search by name, app, or owner
gateway.whyBody: You pick which apps go through it, who can use it, and how. Revoke the token, the whole gateway goes silent — no app-by-app cleanup.
gateway.emptyBody: Group your connected apps into one safe endpoint you can hand to a client, then revoke it in one move.
gateway.offBody: {{name}} is off — every client goes silent.
gateway.name: Name
gateway.profileHelp: The profile decides which tools this gateway allows. You can change it later.
gateway.descriptionPlaceholder: Who this endpoint is for and when it should be rotated.
gateway.noProfiles: Create an access profile under Advanced before adding a gateway.
gateway.oneSafeEndpoint: One safe MCP endpoint that exposes only the apps in its access profile. Hand it to a client like Cursor or Claude Desktop.
gateway.clientDescription: Pick how you’ll point your client at this gateway.
gateway.noSnippets: No client snippets available for this gateway.
gateway.mintHint: Mint a token on the Tokens tab, then paste it where the snippet shows Bearer …. You won’t see a token’s full value again after it’s created.
gateway.tokenWarning: Treat this like a password. Anyone with the token can call exactly the tools this gateway allows. If it leaks, revoke it — the client goes silent immediately.

overview.toggleHelp: Toggle the whole gateway off here.
overview.whoCanUseBody: Anyone holding an active token below, restricted by the rules in the bound profile.
overview.noApps: This gateway’s profile doesn’t include any apps yet.

appsPanel.description: These apps go through this gateway. The bound profile{{profile}} decides which tools are allowed{{tools}} Change the profile under Advanced.
appsPanel.noApps: No apps are assigned to this gateway’s profile yet.

activity.description: Every call through this gateway in the last 7 days, with why it was allowed, blocked, or paused.
activity.noCalls: No calls have gone through this gateway yet.

advanced.dangerBody: Archiving takes the gateway offline for every client. Existing tokens stop working. Type the gateway name to confirm.
advanced.confirmAria: Type the gateway name to confirm archive

tokens.description: Each token is a separate way in. Revoke any one without breaking the others.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.createdBody: You won’t see the full value again. Store it in your client’s config or your secret manager.
tokens.noTokens: No tokens yet. Mint one for the client that will connect to this gateway.
tokens.recorded: Every mint, reveal, and revoke is recorded in Activity.
tokens.revokeBody: Any client using {{name}} goes silent immediately. This can’t be undone. Type the token name to confirm.
tokens.confirmAria: Type the token name to confirm
tokens.mintedBody: Copy it now — you won’t see the full value again.
